_comment: Curated trigger/payload prose for generated event-catalog rows (gen_event_catalog.py). Keys MUST be event types the scanned seams declare — unknown keys fail generation so this file cannot rot. Content lifted from the hand-authored DT-16 catalog (wicked-bus SPEC, 2026-08-29) and from the producing modules' doc contracts.

wicked.qe.gate.passed.trigger: Acceptance gate PASS (garden qe gate CLI)

wicked.test.evidence.captured.trigger: Evidence written for a run (ledger `verdicts.create` with `vault_payload_sha`; union payload)

wicked.crew.membership.attached.trigger: Run attached to a crew project; `domain` stamp `wicked-crew`

wicked.crew.membership.detached.trigger: Run detached from a crew project; `domain` stamp `wicked-crew`

wicked.crew.run.requested.trigger: Governed run intent (human CLI / scheduler / campaign); `domain` stamp = the requester's own — the engine's launch poller matches by event type, not domain

wicked.crew.run.launched.trigger: Launch confirmed by the engine (bus-as-truth handoff); `domain` stamp `wicked-core`; idempotency-keyed on the run id

wicked.crew.task.dispatched.trigger: Workflow unit handoff to a governed worker; `domain` stamp `wicked-core`

wicked.crew.task.completed.trigger: Workflow unit completion (verdict in payload); `domain` stamp `wicked-core`

wicked.gate.eval.requested.trigger: Governed evaluator bus round-trip — request (evaluator≠creator); `domain` stamp `wicked-core`

wicked.gate.eval.responded.trigger: Governed evaluator bus round-trip — response; `domain` stamp `wicked-core`
wicked.gate.eval.responded.payload: evaluation verdict for the paired request

wicked.estate.rule.ingested.trigger: Every rule `wicked-core rules ingest` registers (after its store commit; JSON-bundle and markdown-doc lanes)

wicked.estate.rule.retired.trigger: `retire_rule` after its store commit — only on an actual state change (re-retiring emits nothing)

wicked.estate.doc.drifted.trigger: Drift tooling (`wicked-core rules drift`) — once per drifted governed doc

wicked.crew.governance.conformance_recor.trigger: ConformanceClaim recorded by the governance engine (`wicked-governance src/engine.rs`)

wicked.interactive.artifact.created.trigger: Artifact scaffolded via the wicked-interactive CLI (`src/artifact/create.js`)

wicked.team.path.started.trigger: E: launch admitted, PA seat known (required transition)

wicked.team.path.scored.trigger: E: intent score at plan time; diff re-score from the supervisor's `TeamRescored`

wicked.team.plan.proposed.trigger: E: a plan or plan change was submitted (command or step result)

wicked.team.plan.revised.trigger: E: the plan grew (floor raised, PA added, member request)

wicked.team.plan.accepted.trigger: E: composed, floor-filled, approved or auto-released (required transition)

wicked.team.plan.refused.trigger: E: compose refused a proposal; the run keeps its accepted rev

wicked.team.member.joined.trigger: S: a monitor session opened (or failed to)
wicked.team.member.joined.payload: `member_id`, `open_seq`, `seat`, `role`, `status`, `reason`, `error`; key: ord, attempt, `member_id`, `open_seq`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.member.left.trigger: S: a monitor session closed (completed, budget exhausted, failed, timed out)
wicked.team.member.left.payload: `member_id`, `open_seq`, `seat`, `status`, `batches`, `error`; key: ord, attempt, `member_id`, `open_seq`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.step.claimed.trigger: R: before the step's turn starts
wicked.team.step.claimed.payload: `step_id`, `role`, `kind`, `phase`, `criterion`, `baseline_tree`, `repo`, `code_graph_db`; key: `step_id`, attempt, by; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.checkpoint.reached.trigger: R (carrier): terminal `tool_call_update` of a team unit
wicked.team.checkpoint.reached.payload: `seq`, `tool_call_id`, `kind`, `title`, `status`, `paths`; key: ord, attempt, `seq`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.finding.raised.trigger: S: a confirmed, above-bar, first-seen finding
wicked.team.finding.raised.payload: `raise_seq`, `finding_id`, `member_id`, `severity`, `path`, `line`, `evidence`, `claim`, `suggestion`, `tree`, `in_diff`, `corroborated_by`; key: ord, attempt, `raise_seq`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.advice.delivered.trigger: R: one row per finding per delivery (mid-turn steer, step boundary, attempt end)
wicked.team.advice.delivered.payload: `raise_seq`, `finding_id`, `delivery_id`, `steer_id`, `channel`, `outcome`, `detail`; key: ord, attempt, `raise_seq`, `delivery_id`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.advice.answered.trigger: R: the PA's `ADVICE` line at the end of its turn
wicked.team.advice.answered.payload: `raise_seq`, `answered_in`, `finding_id`, `disposition`, `reason`; key: ord, attempt, `raise_seq`, `answered_in`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.help.requested.trigger: R: the PA asks the team (`HELP:` line)
wicked.team.help.requested.payload: `help_id`, `help_seq`, `question`, `context`; key: `help_id` (minted from `help_seq`, never the question); plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.help.answered.trigger: S: a member answers a help request

wicked.team.change.requested.trigger: S: a member asks for plan steps

wicked.team.step.completed.payload: `step_id`, `status`, `tree`, `output_bytes`, `output_ref`; key: `step_id`, attempt, by; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.step.reviewed.trigger: R: the PA accepted or rejected a member's step (`STEP` line)

wicked.team.finding.settled.trigger: S: the hold round (held / withdrawn) or re-confirmation (superseded)
wicked.team.finding.settled.payload: `raise_seq`, `finding_id`, `status`, `reason`, `final_line`; key: ord, attempt, `raise_seq`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.council.called.trigger: S: an unresolved HIGH or a member-step dispute goes to a one-off council
wicked.team.council.called.payload: `subject`, `finding_id`, `trigger`, `question`, `positions`, `evidence`, `excluded_seats`, `transcript`; key: ord, attempt, `subject`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.council.ruled.trigger: S: the verdict of the council it convened
wicked.team.council.ruled.payload: `subject`, `verdict`, `reason`, `task_id`, `consensus`, `agreement_pct`, `dissent`, `returned`, `seated`; key: ord, attempt, `subject`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.ledger.folded.trigger: S: the final pass folded the attempt's stream into its TeamLedger
wicked.team.ledger.folded.payload: `final_pass`, `ledger`, `transport`, `transcript`; key: ord, attempt; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.gate.opened.trigger: E: a gate opened (`unit_review`, `plan_approval`, `team_dispute`, `team_transport`; required transition)
wicked.team.gate.opened.payload: `gate_id`, `kind` + kind fields; key: `gate_id`; plus the envelope `run_id`, `ord`, `attempt`, `by`, `at`, `re`

wicked.team.gate.decided.trigger: E: a gate decided (the fold, or a human decision after `confirm_gate`; required transition)

wicked.team.path.ended.trigger: E: the run reached a terminal state
